_policy: The v86 sweep's quarantine list. Same policy and same loader as
entry needs an id, a reason and an ISO expires date, the list is capped,
and on the expiry date the entry stops shielding so the sweep goes red
again and someone has to fix, delete or consciously renew it.
These 13 stories drive the REAL tmux running in the emulated x86 guest and
have never passed there — the nightly sweep was red every night with this
exact set, which is the same as having no nightly at all. They are listed
so the sweep reports a NEW failure instead of drowning it, not because any
of them is acceptable. Tracked in https://github.com/flplima/tmuxy/issues/87.
maxEntries is a ratchet: it only ever goes DOWN. Fixing a story means
deleting its entry and lowering the cap in the same commit.

entries.reason: wheel-up does not enter copy mode against the guest's tmux; the same flow passes against the mocked adapter, so the gap is in what the real control-mode path does with a wheel event.
The alternate-screen half of the same wheel-to-copy-mode gap.
Drag does not enter client copy mode ('expected undefined to be truthy'); same area as the wheel entries.
Word/line selection reads back empty instead of the target word.
The pane height does not grow — 'expected 40 to be greater than 40', i.e. the resize never reached the guest's tmux.
A repeated resize binding overshoots badly (77.25 against a budget of 15): the repeat is applied more times than it was sent.
The font-size shortcut lands on the wrong size (59 where 71 is expected).

The failure path reads null where the error surface is expected. Related to the TransportError the guest adapter raises for 'show-environment -g TMUXY_SWITCH_TO' — that query is not supported by this adapter, and it is also the source of most of the run's console errors.
The glitch detector trips during the optimistic zoom (3 node / 10 attr mutations).
The optimistic rename reads back null instead of the new name.
The tab is named 'Pane %3' — a raw tmux pane id where the format string should have been expanded. Looks like a real formatting bug rather than a guest-timing one.
The image widget renders without its 'Back' control.
The detected URL is truncated to 'https://examp/' — the autolink reads a clipped cell range out of the guest's grid.
